partition_policy: 60% train, 24-bar purge+embargo, 20% validation, 24-bar purge+embargo, final 20% untouched

incumbent_liquidity_sweep.definition: 20-bar prior high/low sweep with close back through extreme and body ratio >= 0.50
incumbent_liquidity_sweep.reason: negative validation expectancy; no evidence for promotion

challenger_vwap_volume_sweep.definition: same sweep concept plus session-VWAP side, candle direction, and volume >= 0.75x prior-20 average
challenger_vwap_volume_sweep.reason: large train/validation sign reversal and very small validation sample

conclusion: Neither component is promoted. Challenger training performance was not robust to validation.
